fixtures.case_note: A path-qualified patch-package postinstall applies version-controlled local patches, so it is not a meaningful install hook: the URL-dep/hostile pair stays off while the hook declaration and extensionless-path observations remain.
A real install hook (node script) paired with a direct-URL runtime dependency retains the hostile verdict.

purpose: patch-package spelling controls for install-hook filtering: bare, npx, and node_modules/.bin invocations are inert; genuine hooks still convict.
